title: Maccabi Tel-Aviv defend Winner League title
description: M.Tel-Aviv - H.Tel-Aviv 82-74 Maccabi Tel-Aviv repeated as Winner League champions. They overcame Hapoel Tel-Aviv in the decisive third game of the Finals to defend the title. Hapoel Tel-Aviv was trailing by 1 point at halftime but managed to get 1-point lead after three quarters before a 28-19 charge of Maccabi Tel-Aviv, which allowed them to win the game. M.Tel-Aviv outrebounded H.Tel-Aviv 46-25 including a 27-16 advantage in defensive rebounds. M.Tel-Aviv looked well-organized offensively handing out 21 assists. It was a great evening for the former international power forward Roman Sorkin (210-1996, college: Oregon) who led his team to a victory scoring 19 points and 9 rebounds. Cuban power forward Jasiel Rivero (206-1993, agency: Pro Sports) helped adding 16 points and 8 rebounds (on 7-of-8 shooting from the field).
